run_create_inaturalist2018_data_files: run the script to create iNaturalist2018 train and validation numpy data files from input directory
run_download_dataset: run the download_dataset function to download and extract iNaturalist2018 annotations and images to input directory
run_get_images_labels_info: run get_images_labels_info to extract image paths and labels from iNaturalist2018 JSON annotation files
run_main: run the main CLI entry point with input and output directory arguments to generate train and val numpy arrays
summarize_create_inaturalist2018_data_fi: summarize the script that converts iNaturalist2018 JSON annotations into numpy source and label files
